statement: For a BK-tuple, the discriminant components are the Cayley discriminants of nonprelinear simple BK-subtuples (codimension one), together with those of prelinear simple BK-subtuples not contained in any nonprelinear simple BK-subtuple (codimension two). In particular, a nonlinear irreducible BK-tuple has an irreducible discriminant hypersurface. Simple means not a union of proper BK-subtuples; prelinear means the quotient by the unique maximal proper BK-subtuple is linear.

answer.text: Classifies discriminant components by simple BK-subtuples and their codimensions, including irreducibility and hypersurface status for nonlinear irreducible tuples.

notes:
Discriminant, Cayley discriminant and mixed discriminant are distinct objects in this paper. The extracted component theorem concerns the full system discriminant; the Cayley discriminants appearing in the formula are the component-defining objects.

scope: Square sparse systems whose translated supports generate their lattice and form a BK-tuple: total defect zero and every subtuple has nonnegative defect; defect is affine dimension of the Minkowski sum minus number of supports.
